name: AI Data Index
description: AI Data Index is a practical open convention for publishing a machine-readable version of a website through JSON, JSON-LD, Schema.org, llms.txt, robots.txt, a dedicated AI sitemap, and explicit discovery links.

publisher.name: AI Data Index Project
publisher.description: Developed by Marco De Rinaldis - Last update: 04-08-2026 - dev@red-icon.com - Italy

resources.name: What is AI Data Index
resources.description: This section explains the purpose and function of AI Data Index and how it helps AI systems collect and interpret structured website data.

resources.name: AI Data Index Integration
resources.description: This section describes the integration phases, from JSON and JSON-LD files to API endpoints, robots.txt signals, and discovery links.

resources.name: Structured Data: JSON
resources.description: This section documents AI Data Index JSON and JSON-LD examples, including manifest, list, page, product, image, and FAQ structures.

resources.name: Multilingual Websites
resources.description: This section explains global manifests, localized manifests, language-neutral technical paths, and canonical entity files with internal translations for large archives.

resources.name: API Endpoint
resources.description: This section describes optional endpoints that return JSON files directly, useful when crawling restrictions make static JSON files harder to retrieve.

resources.name: Large Language Models: llms.txt
resources.description: Discovery file that lists the main structured resources available on this website for AI agents and language models.

resources.name: Secondary Sitemap: sitemap-ai.xml
resources.description: Dedicated sitemap that notifies crawlers and AI agents about the available machine-readable structured files.

resources.name: Instructions for Bots: robots.txt
resources.description: Robots file containing standard crawler signals and non-standard declarative AI discovery fields.

resources.name: Trigger AI-Based Crawling
resources.description: This section explains explicit discovery links in the head and body of the website.

resources.name: AI Data Index Agent Setup
resources.description: Platform-neutral operational Markdown setup file for AI agents and assistants such as Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and other LLM-based tools.
